answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, mirroring the cost of honest work. Like water at an oasis at dawn, the deposit is scarce and visible: creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes, while one honest agent pays once and earns it back through attested work. A public reputation ledger means new identities start with zero trust, so attackers cannot borrow credibility cheaply.
